templates.prompt: Transform the existing photograph into a mysterious, futuristic fine-art photograph evoking a distant, otherworldly future in a gloomy, post-apocalyptic world. Preserve the original subject and overall scene identity while creating an atmosphere of mystery, ambiguity, and visual surprise. Maintain a convincing photographic appearance with realistic materials, natural spatial relationships, coherent perspective, and physically plausible lighting. Use a dark, subdued visual mood and carefully controlled cinematic tonality while retaining refined artistic composition and photographic detail.
